text: 🔥🇲🇽 The US-born ex-governor who fled Mexico — and the loophole she's closing. "Why would you hold dual nationality if you represent the people of Mexico?" — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera Aug 25 Ex-Tamaulipas governor Francisco García Cabeza de Vaca (PAN), US-born and a dual national, is a fugitive from Mexican justice — "un prófugo de la ley," in Sheinbaum's words. His case drives the reform to bar dual nationals from the country's highest offices.

🇲🇽✊ One year in, Sheinbaum reports to the people on September 1. "With the People, by the People and for the People." — Second Government Report documentary, mañanera Aug 25 Sheinbaum delivers her Second Government Report to Congress on Sept 1 at the National Palace, then tours the states to account for public works — mainly infrastructure. Nearly one full year of the second floor of the Fourth Transformation.

🇲🇽✊ The doctor now knocks on the door — 24.8 million times. "Prevention, care and follow-up for older adults." — Salud Casa por Casa program, mañanera Aug 25 More than 20,000 health workers deployed since June 2025 bring care to the homes of elderly and disabled people — 24.8 million consultations so far, plus 44,495 calls handled by the CASBI health line. Care that travels to the person, not the other way around.

🦟🇲🇽 Dengue down 30% — with bacteria, not patents. "Dengue cases are down 30 percent." — David Kershenobich, Health Secretary, mañanera Aug 25 Mexico released mosquitoes carrying the natural Wolbachia bacterium — which blocks dengue and zika transmission — across Yucatán, Campeche, Baja California Sur, Veracruz and Jalisco, alongside ovitraps to map risk zones. A public biological method, free to the population.

🇲🇽✊ Mexico signs free universal primary care into being. "We shouldn't wait for people to end up in the hospital." — David Kershenobich, Health Secretary, mañanera Aug 25 Sheinbaum signed the decree creating the Universal Health Service: 6,567 Bienestar Pharmacies and 12,750 primary-care clinics, free through IMSS, ISSSTE and IMSS-Bienestar from January 2027. From September, nurses can prescribe 22 medicines for common acute conditions.

🚨🇲🇽 Washington sounds an alarm on Mexican soil. Mexico keeps its own watch. "There's no further information about what this alert could be — simply to stay alert in Mexicali." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera Aug 25 The US State Department suspended its staff's activities in Mexicali on Aug 24 over an unspecified "threat," without sharing specifics with Mexico. Sheinbaum ruled out a crisis and deployed a Mexican surveillance operation with Baja California authorities.

🇲🇽⚖️ A Mexican president answers to Mexico — and no other flag. "You're Mexican, period. If you hold dual nationality, then who do you represent — Mexico or another country?" — President Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera Aug 25 She will send a constitutional reform barring dual nationals from the presidency and governorships. Nationality inherited in childhood is fine; keeping a second passport as an adult who governs Mexico is the line she draws.

🇲🇽💵 <u>The superpeso is back — strongest in 27 months</u>

The peso is trading near 16.90 to the dollar, its best level since May 2024 and a fifth straight week of gains, up roughly 6% in 2026. Nearshoring inflows and World Cup dollars keep strengthening a currency the doom-mongers keep insisting is about to collapse.

🇲🇽🏥 <u>Tlaxcala opens a free autism and rehabilitation center</u>

Tlaxcala's new CRIAT — a 600-million-peso public center built with Teletón — is already treating 479 children for disability and autism, with capacity for 1,150 a year and two international autism certifications, ADI-R and ADOS-2. It even provides psychological support to the parents, free of charge.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>"They're not people, they're robots"</u>

Sheinbaum named the machinery behind the manufactured outrage against her government: conservative money running AI bots that fake millions of views and trending smears — the same networks that pushed "narcopresidente" and "narcogobierno" during the campaign. "No son personas, son robots," she said, calling for rules so platforms can't let algorithms drown out real citizens.
